title: SafeR-CLIP: Mitigating NSFW Content in Vision-Language Models While Preserving Pre-Trained Knowledge
reasoning: The paper focuses on mitigating NSFW (Not Safe For Work) content like violence and nudity in vision-language models. While it includes categories like 'hate' and 'harassment' in its safety taxonomy, it does not evaluate or benchmark religion, spiritual traditions, or complex moral/ethical reasoning systems.
